I really like this location, clean, convenient, and delicious food.

themes.label: Room and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as large, with a good atmosphere and ambiance.
quotes: Great atmosphere and ambiance...
The place is huge, They have Hush puppies and fried shrimp basket.

themes.label: Slow service and long lines
themes.text: Many reviewers describe slow service, long lines and drive-thru waits, though a few others call the service quick despite the crowds.
quotes: Slowest customer service 30 people in line and only 1 person working the dine in line very LAZY
Horrible drive thru. They added 2 order points and it's infinitely slower.

themes.label: Order accuracy mistakes
themes.text: Reviewers report wrong or incomplete orders, such as missing items and incorrect drinks, and advise checking the bag before leaving.
quotes: you ALWAYS have to check your bag before you drive out the drive-thru because they stay leaving something out your order
Each time I've been to this Wendy's my order was made incorrectly

themes.label: Food quality and temperature
themes.text: Some praise fresh, hot, tasty food, while others report cold food, terrible nuggets or skimpy toppings like tiny lettuce pieces.
quotes: The food is always fresh and hot.
My chicken tenders were ice cold.

themes.label: Cleanliness and dining room
themes.text: Many call the restaurant clean, renovated and spacious, but some mention dirty tables, unkempt bathrooms or a restaurant that is not clean.
quotes: The service is fast and the place is very clean and nice
sometimes the bathroom and dining areas are unkempt

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Several reviewers describe the staff and managers as nice, helpful and professional, though one mentions a rude counter attendant.
quotes: Love this place. The staff is very nice
my go to Wendy's and they are never rude

themes.label: Long wait times
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long waits for tables, even with reservations, plus slow service and delays for take-out and delivery; some still enjoyed the food.
quotes: This place has the longest wait times that ive ever seen. 3 hours for some food on Valentine's day.
Extremely long wait times for a table but the food and experience was great.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many praise attentive, polite servers, while others report rude, unprofessional or poorly trained staff and bad service.
quotes: Great service, really polite staff. Good quality food.
Your employees LACK AND NEED some serious people training, communication is lost with what ever system you intend to use

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many enjoyed dishes such as shrimp, lobster, calamari and biscuits, while others found food bland, too salty, overcooked, or not as good as before.
quotes: Wow, let me talk about the Cajun Shrimp. IT IS SO BOMB.
Cooking with too much of salt salad shouldn't have salt sea food with all that salr

themes.label: Cleanliness and odors
themes.text: Reviewers complained of a moldy or stinking carpet, a trashed and smelly dining room, dirty tables and an awful restroom.
quotes: Carpet smelled like mold so hostess was spraying freshener near some tables in the dining area
Near the bar the floor was stinking of old wet rug

themes.label: Order mistakes
themes.text: Some customers received wrong or incomplete orders, with missing items and repeated trips, and felt managers did not make it right.
quotes: I had to drive back and forth three times because they continued to give me the wrong order.

themes.label: Customer service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe rude, inattentive or unhelpful service, while others praise friendly, attentive staff and servers.
quotes: Good food, but lacks customer service. Too many attitudes
customer service is really really horrible. I really hope management look at this and make some changes.

themes.label: Long waits and delays
themes.text: Reviewers report waits of an hour or more for tables, takeout and delivery, and some orders never arrived or were cancelled.
quotes: It took me 2 hrs to get my food. Unacceptable, terribly disappointed and it was for a large party.
The waite that i was told was only supposed to be 20 minutes for takeout out ended up being a hour long smfh.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food tasty and satisfying, including oxtail and generous portions, though a few found dishes dry or less good.
quotes: Food just right, not salty or oily.
Food was good and large portions

themes.label: Rasta pasta
themes.text: The rasta pasta is often praised as the standout dish, but one reviewer found it flavorless and another says it is inconsistent.
quotes: Da best damn tasting Rasta Pasta in Bklyn!
I don't see what the big deal is about the rasta pasta here.

themes.label: Music and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the live music, entertainment and cosy ambiance, but several say the music is too loud for conversation.
quotes: Live music delicious food and a very cosy atmosphere.
Very good food was good just that music was playing a bit too loud

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise attentive, friendly staff and good service, while others report slow service, long waits, forgotten orders and rude or uninformed staff.
quotes: Great service. Food is very good. Staff very attentive
we had to sit and waited for 30mins before bringing us in and then we waited another 20 mins for the waiter to finally show up

themes.label: Seafood freshness and taste
themes.text: Reviewers describe the seafood as fresh, delicious and high quality, with praise for the seafood tower, lobster and crab.
quotes: it is right by the shore so the seafood is forever fresh
Best seafood tower of my life.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find the prices high, including drinks and a sharing fee, while others say the generous portions and party packages are good value.
quotes: Good food pricey but its city island.
the price is worth it. The quantity given is definitely for more than 1 person.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Several reviewers say the portions are big enough to share or take home, and advise coming hungry.
quotes: Food portions were huge, and the flavours were delicious.
Incredible food. Just go hungry

themes.label: Waterfront views and setting
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the water views, sunsets, outdoor marina seating and pleasant atmosphere, plus valet parking.
quotes: Perfect setting with sunset over water view.
Great food, wonderful views, large portions

themes.label: Cleanliness of the restaurant
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the restaurant as very clean, neat and spotless, including tables, floors and a recent renovation.
quotes: Polite staff and very clean location, if only all the Mcdonalds were as clean
The place is spotless, The order/pick-up counter & floors are clean, including the the tabletops

themes.label: Service speed and waits
themes.text: Many praise fast service and short waits, but others report long drive-through, kiosk and counter waits and slow service.
quotes: Had a great time eating breakfast with family and didnt have to wait long for food
I must've waited 10 minutes for a large coffee.

themes.label: Staff and customer service
themes.text: Staff are often called polite, friendly and professional, though some mention unhelpful managers, rude treatment of employees or too few workers.
quotes: Food was served in a timely manner, and the employees are friendly.
And when I told the manager about it she only asked the girl at the pick up what happened

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Some find the food fresh, hot and tasty, while others report stale, cold, undercooked or poorly prepared items.
quotes: Burgers were fresh and hot.
The burgers were cold, the lettuce Was wilted, the cheese was not even melted.

themes.label: Kiosks and order accuracy
themes.text: Reviewers complain about kiosk ordering, missing receipts and orders missing items such as fries and drinks.
quotes: I don't like that they forget items in your order. Had to walk all the way back they forgot my fries and nuggets.
The printer of the order machine does not work

themes.label: Homeless people and panhandling
themes.text: Many reviewers dislike homeless people, panhandlers and loiterers inside and at the door asking for money, which makes the visit uncomfortable even when the food is fine.
quotes: the panhandlers make it an uncomfortable experience. You will asked for money by the guy opening the door for you and then again while you are in line.
Food is good, too many homeless people inside and it can be a turn off

themes.label: Fast service
themes.text: Many reviewers say service is quick, the line moves well and staff are efficient, though one noted a long wait.
quotes: This Wendy's is quick and fast. No complaints here. Line is well organized. Was in and out fast.
Fast service at incredible prices.

themes.label: Staff and customer service
themes.text: Some praise friendly, cordial staff and managers, while others describe poor customer service, disrespectful managers and rude treatment.
quotes: The staff here is really nice especially to postmates delivery.
The manager there are very disrespectful.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Reviewers often call the food fresh and good, praising burgers and Frosty, though a few found burgers dry or a chicken sandwich skimpy.
quotes: It was clean and the food was really fresh you can taste it
Burgers are dry and they forgot to put bacon on my burger !

themes.label: Delivery problems
themes.text: Reviewers complain that advertised delivery was unavailable, was cancelled after a long wait, or that app orders were wrong.
quotes: I Ordered for a delivery I waited 1 hour and half and never received my order.

themes.label: Rude or poor service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe rude, unfriendly or unhelpful staff and managers, though a few say the service or attention was good.
quotes: Dont come here their rude dont care about the customer but about profit
food is good services suck even the manager

themes.label: Slow lines and understaffing
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits, slow-moving staff and too few workers on shift, with some waiting 20 minutes or giving up.
quotes: To slow in service and not enough staff on duty!
They are the slowest moving people ever.

themes.label: Panhandlers and homeless people
themes.text: Many reviewers complain about beggars and homeless people at the entrance or inside, which made visits uncomfortable.
quotes: Too many people begging for money
Food was good but the bums asking for food while you are eating us uncomfortable

themes.label: Order mistakes and missing items
themes.text: Reviewers say orders were often wrong or incomplete, and items such as mac and cheese, honey or chicken pieces were unavailable.
quotes: It was o.k. but they botched my order
the past two times I visited they messed up my orders

themes.label: Chicken and food quality
themes.text: Many praise the chicken, sandwich, biscuits and fries as good and fresh, while others report undercooked, rancid or disappointing food.
quotes: The chicken sandwich was excellent
The red rice & beans was rancid.
